title: Robotiq 2F-85 · 양 jaw 40 N · native mechanism

report.scope: native closed-loop gripper clamp on FREE calibration block, given initial grasp, component test only

mechanics.mechanics: native MuJoCo unconstrained mass (separate armature), gravity and body FK vs independent Pinocchio

settings.velocity_limit_source: declared planning bound, consistent with PickNik 2F-85 URDF; not motor identification
settings.claim: Manufacturer ranges are references. The smaller simulation capacity must pass native finite-actuator clamp tests; it is not hardware calibration.

description: Gripper component verification, separate from the multi-arm paper task. Original Robotiq mesh, native four-bar constraints and finite 5 Nm actuator; a free block held by two measured 40 N jaw reactions. Virtual PMI force admittance drives the native position servo. No object weld or pose playback drives the physics.
